wargear.name: Vow of Silence
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Every Sister has sworn a vow of quiet, and the unit's presence is a cold hole in the warp. Enemy Psykers within 6" of the unit suffer -1 to every Psychic Check they make.

wargear.name: Oblivion-forged aegis
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A shield-plate wrought in the Throne Room's own foundries, hungry to unmake what strikes it. The bearer gains a 4+ Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Null-lattice hull
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. The Acquisitor's hull is lined with a mesh of soulless iron, built for hauling the damned through the Black Ships' corridors. The vehicle gains +1 Front armour value.

wargear.name: Soul-dampener collar
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A choker of black iron that drinks the warp-light from the air around it.

wargear.name: Null-iron rosary
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A string of beads cast from the black iron of the Palace dungeons.

wargear.name: Hushed bell
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A bell with no clapper that, when swung, rings only inside the mind.

wargear.name: Verdict-seal manacles
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Warded iron cuffs bearing a sentence already pronounced.

wargear.name: Cell-lock grapnels
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Spring-fed grapnels fired from the Acquisitor's flanks to snare running prey.

wargear.name: Revealing lumen
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hard white searchlight that strips cover and shadow from whatever it falls on.

rules.name: Silent Hunt
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Vow of the Silent Hunt). An enemy Psyker within 12" of a unit with this rule subtracts 1 from its Willpower while it is there.

rules.name: Oblivion Charge
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Oblivion Knights Ride). A unit with this rule may declare a Charge on the turn it disembarks from a transport. If an enemy Psyker or Malefic unit is within its charge reach, it must charge one.

rules.name: Incorruptible Engines
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Black Ships' Writ). Enemy Psychic powers can't target a model with this rule, and it is unaffected by Corruption and Malefic abilities.

rules.name: Dampening Pall
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy Psykers within 12" of the bearer subtract 1 from their Psychic Checks.

rules.name: Rosary of Quiet
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The bearer gains Feel No Pain (6+).

rules.name: Muting Toll
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of the enemy Shooting phase, choose one enemy unit within 18". It may not use Psychic weapons or Force (X) until the end of the phase.

rules.name: Seal of Arrest
rules.text: Legacy house rule. If the bearer's unit wins an Assault with a Psyker or Malefic unit, that unit gains the Stunned Status.

rules.name: Snare Volley
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, one enemy Infantry unit within 12" at the start of its controller's Movement phase must pass a Cool Check or gain the Pinned Status.

rules.name: Truth Beam
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy units within 24" of the Acquisitor lose Shrouded (X) and Infiltrate (X) benefits against its Shooting Attacks.

armyRules.name: Soulless Resolve
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Sisters feel no warp-born dread and give no warmth to it either. Anathema models ignore Fear and add 1 to their Cool, but may not be targeted by friendly Psychic powers or benefit from friendly Feel No Pain-granting abilities.

armyRules.name: Quarry Marked
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A cadre hunts the gifted by sight. A Null Sister adds 1 to her Hit Tests against units containing a Psyker or Malefic model; against other targets she suffers -1 to Hit when she Shoots at over 12".
armyRules.condition: when targeting a Psyker or Malefic unit

armyRules.name: Cell-Block Hold
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Acquisitor is a moving prison and smells like one. Enemy units within 6" of an Acquisitor subtract 1 from their Cool. Its hold is cramped by cells, so its Capacity is reduced by 2.

rites.name: Vow of the Silent Hunt
rites.flavor: They do not shout. They do not speak. The witch notices only that her prayers have stopped working.
benefits: Kharon Pattern Acquisitors may fill Troops slots.
Anathema Cadres gain Infiltrate (9) and Silent Hunt: an enemy Psyker within 12" takes -1 to its Willpower.
limitations: At least two Anathema Cadres are required.

modifiers.text: Vow of the Silent Hunt: Infiltrate (9), Silent Hunt.

require.note: At least two Cadres take the vow.

rites.name: The Oblivion Knights Ride
rites.flavor: Even the Silent Sisterhood needs someone to carry a sword where the witch-fire cannot reach.
benefits: Knight-Centuras may fill Troops and Elites slots, gain Line (1) and +1 Attack.
They gain Oblivion Charge: a unit may Charge on the turn it disembarks from a transport.
limitations: At least two Knight-Centuras are required.
A Knight-Centura that can charge an enemy Psyker or Malefic unit must do so.

modifiers.text: The Oblivion Knights Ride: +1 A, Line (1), Oblivion Charge.

require.note: At least two Oblivion Knights ride.

rites.name: The Black Ships' Writ
rites.flavor: When the Sisters cannot be everywhere, the Throne lends them machines that cannot be tempted.
benefits: Castellax Battle and Destructor Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Incorruptible Engines: enemy Psychic powers can't target them.
limitations: At least two Castellax Maniples are required.
No more than one Anathema Cadre.

modifiers.text: The Black Ships' Writ: Line (1), Incorruptible Engines.
